description: Numeric benchmarks for product transactional emails (2025 SaaS/product context). Rules and structural guidance stay in references/email.md — this file covers only the measurable targets.
context_note: Open rates are no longer a reliable primary metric. Apple Mail Privacy Protection (MPP) pre-loads email content for ~46% of email users, inflating open rate data by up to 18 points. Track click-to-open rate (CTOR) and click-through rate (CTR) instead.

benchmarks.target: 8x higher opens and clicks than marketing emails
